Can I change the shipping address on an order I just placed?
If it’s within 20 minutes of placing your order, we can update the shipping address (and we can also remove items or cancel). We can’t add items to an order once it’s placed.
If it’s already processed or shipped, we won’t be able to change the address. If you’d like, you can tap Contact Support and our team can take a look at your options.

Can I cancel an order after placing it, and is there a time window?
menu
Yes—there’s a 20-minute window after placing your order where we can make changes, including canceling it.
Once an order has already processed or shipped from our warehouse, we can’t make changes or cancel it. In that case, you can refuse the package upon delivery, and once tracking updates showing it’s returning to us, reach out and we can help you place an updated order.
Order status

Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
Once an order has been placed, we’re not able to add items to it (even within the 20-minute change window).
If you still want the extra item, the best move is to place a new order for everything you need. If you send us your new order number, we can refund the standard shipping cost on that new order.
